source_identity_correction.reason: The diagnostic launch supplied an incorrectly transcribed commit label; frozen source hashes match the verified baseline exactly. Original command and receipts remain unchanged.

profile_baseline.source_label_note: The original diagnostic CLI commit was transcribed incorrectly; it is retained unchanged. Exact frozen manifests establish baseline identity and the separate correction records the actual source-host commit.

caveats: One two-second repetition per uninstrumented point; no repeat variability estimate.
Do not pool changed sources, compact/split CPU placements, or instrumented profile rates.
Flat cpu-clock samples identify where worker CPU time was sampled; they do not isolate NUMA traffic or stall causes.
NO_JIT points cannot establish benefits from writer delegation; all read bodies remain local.
kd_mutex_osq_lock is shared by reader admission and the embedded mutex gate. No callgraph was captured; flat samples cannot directly separate reader versus writer queue waits.
Named combiner/execute symbol shares are not total JIT overhead. Unresolved samples are retained separately and are not assumed to be generated bodies.

causal_notes: The same 32 workers and payload run changes placement from CPUs 0–31 to 0–15 plus 32–47. This isolates worker placement from worker count, but remains one observation per placement and preserves any JIT-class difference.
Colocated and striped screens remain separate source generations, including regressions and neutral cases. The cohort screen is not pooled with them.
Flat sampled queue-function names do not identify each caller, cacheline-transfer latency, or memory-stall causes. Profile rates remain separate from uninstrumented throughput.
